definition: X is a part of Y. X is a component, subassembly, subsystem, or structural element that constitutes, belongs to, or is contained within Y.
inverse_definition: Y has X as a part. Y contains, holds, or is composed of X as a component or subassembly.

definition: X has Y as a component, attribute, or feature. Y is something X possesses, includes, carries, or holds as part of its structure.
inverse_definition: Y belongs to X. Y is possessed by, included in, or carried by X as part of its structure.

definition: X is used for Y. X serves as a tool, power source, or operator that enables, activates, powers, drives, supplies, feeds, or runs Y.
inverse_definition: Y is used by X. Y is enabled, activated, powered, driven, supplied, or fed by X as a tool or operator.

definition: X causes Y. X is an event or action that triggers, fires, produces, initiates, induces, modulates, or results in Y.
inverse_definition: Y is caused by X. Y is triggered, produced, initiated, induced, modulated, or results from X.

definition: X is capable of acting on Y. X can direct, command, control, regulate, govern, manage, plan, schedule, or coordinate Y.
inverse_definition: Y is acted on by X. Y is directed, commanded, controlled, regulated, governed, managed, or coordinated by X.

definition: X is a Y. X is a subtype, classification, instance, kind, category, or variant of Y. X is a more specific form of Y.
inverse_definition: Y has X as a subtype. Y is a more general category that X instantiates or specialises.
exemplar_phrases: is a more specific form of

definition: X is at location Y. X is physically installed, placed, mounted, situated, housed, or located in or at Y.
inverse_definition: Y is the location of X. Y physically contains, hosts, houses, or situates X.

definition: X is made of Y. X is built, assembled, fabricated, constructed, or manufactured from Y as its material or constituent.
inverse_definition: Y is a component of X. Y is the material or constituent from which X is built, assembled, or manufactured.

definition: X receives an action. X is observed, monitored, measured, sensed, detected, read, scanned, tracked, or recorded.
inverse_definition: Y performs an action on X. Y observes, monitors, measures, senses, detects, reads, scans, tracks, or records X.

definition: X connects to Y. X physically links, couples, joins, bridges, interfaces, binds, plugs into, or mates with Y.
inverse_definition: Y connects to X. (Symmetric — same as Connects.)

definition: X has Y as a prerequisite. X requires, depends on, needs, or relies on Y. Y must exist or occur before X can happen.
inverse_definition: Y is a prerequisite for X. Y must exist or occur before X can happen; X requires or depends on Y.

definition: X is related to Y. X and Y are associated, linked, involved, or connected in some general way. Used as fallback when no specific relation is identified.
inverse_definition: Y is related to X. (Symmetric — same as RelatedTo.)
